commit_topology.self_reference_note: Result-recording commit is intentionally not self-referential.

record_timeline.human_design_brief: Operator-authored before implementation; it is not a machine commit timestamp.

purpose: Add offline execution measurement integrity and a read-only comparator; do not select or change a cost model.

input_contract.runtime_database: operator-supplied SQLite path; opened mode=ro and query_only
input_contract.executable_bars: required local CSV or manifest; record path, SHA-256, feed identity when known, and coverage window

measurement_contract.raw_event_journal: append-only source-scoped broker cumulative facts; absent fee is unknown, not zero
measurement_contract.ownership: existing net portfolio ownership bookkeeping remains authoritative
measurement_contract.quality: missing, invalid, duplicate, out-of-order, and noncomparable observations remain explicit
measurement_contract.fee_evidence: event-local only; unknown fee blocks actual total-cost comparison
measurement_contract.cross_source_fee_reconciliation: future work; no cross-source precedence is implemented in P0

backtest_benchmark_contract.schedule: next eligible open; 20 positive known-volume bars; 10 percent capacity; residual carry-forward
backtest_benchmark_contract.resolved_dynamic_residual_capacity: A residual order is recreated at the preceding fill bar and uses positive-volume bars known through that boundary; its current fill bar remains excluded.
backtest_benchmark_contract.superseded_statement: Do not freeze one decision-time liquidity estimate across all residual fills.
backtest_benchmark_contract.costs: existing 3 bps adverse price adjustment, crypto taker fee, and effective-dated equity regulatory fees

acceptance.technical_pipeline: accepted after engine differential parity, temporary-worktree isolation, and a base-versus-head full-suite differential; sandbox-denied loopback tests are common to base and head
